title: Systems of coherent modules on the thickenings X_n are coherent formal modules on X
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $S_n=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ ($n\ge0$), $X\to S$ a morphism of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], $X_n=X\times_SS_n$ [def-pc-base-change] with the closed immersions $j_n:X_n\to X$ and $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ ($j_{n+1}i_n=j_n$), and $\mathcal I=I\mathcal O_X$ the quasi-coherent ideal sheaf generated by $I$ (the image of $f^*\widetilde I\to\mathcal O_X$ for the structure morphism $f:X\to S$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal]). Then: (1) $X$ is Noetherian and $j_n$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with ideal sheaf $\mathcal I^{n+1}$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. (2) Let $\mathrm{Sys}$ be the category of systems $(\mathcal F_n,\varphi_n)_{n\ge0}$ of coherent $\mathcal O_{X_n}$-modules $\mathcal F_n$ [pqf-def-coherent] and isomorphisms $\varphi_n:i_n^*\mathcal F_{n+1}\to\mathcal F_n$ [def-pc-module-pullback], a morphism $(\mathcal F_n,\varphi_n)\to(\mathcal G_n,\varphi'_n)$ being a family of $\mathcal O_{X_n}$-linear $u_n:\mathcal F_n\to\mathcal G_n$ with $u_n\circ\varphi_n=\varphi'_n\circ i_n^*u_{n+1}$. The functor sending $(\mathcal F_n,\varphi_n)$ to the inverse system $(j_{n-1,*}\mathcal F_{n-1})_{n\ge1}$, whose transition map $j_{n,*}\mathcal F_n\to j_{n,*}i_{n-1,*}\mathcal F_{n-1}=j_{n-1,*}\mathcal F_{n-1}$ is $j_{n,*}$ of the map $\mathcal F_n\to i_{n-1,*}\mathcal F_{n-1}$ adjoint to $\varphi_{n-1}$, is an equivalence of categories $\mathrm{Sys}\to\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. (3) For a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$, the system $(\mathcal F|_{X_n},c_n)$, $\mathcal F|_{X_n}=j_n^*\mathcal F$ and $c_n:i_n^*(\mathcal F|_{X_{n+1}})\cong\mathcal F|_{X_n}$ the canonical isomorphisms, is sent to an object isomorphic to $\mathcal F^\wedge$, by the isomorphisms $j_{n,*}j_n^*\mathcal F\cong\mathcal F/\mathcal I^{n+1}\mathcal F$, naturally in $\mathcal F$; hence for coherent $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ the families $(u_n:\mathcal G|_{X_n}\to\mathcal F|_{X_n})_{n\ge0}$ with $u_n\circ c_n=c_n\circ i_n^*u_{n+1}$ correspond bijectively to the morphisms $\mathcal G^\wedge\to\mathcal F^\wedge$ of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$, the family $(u|_{X_n})_n$ of an $\mathcal O_X$-linear $u:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$ corresponding to $u^\wedge$, and an isomorphism $\mathcal F^\wedge\cong(j_{n-1,*}\mathcal F_{n-1})_n$ in $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ corresponds to isomorphisms $\psi_n:\mathcal F|_{X_n}\to\mathcal F_n$ with $\varphi_n\circ i_n^*\psi_{n+1}=\psi_n\circ c_n$. (4) For a coherent $\mathcal O_{X_0}$-module $\mathcal F_0$ one has $\operatorname{Supp}(j_{0,*}\mathcal F_0)=j_0(\operatorname{Supp}\mathcal F_0)$, and $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F_0)$ is proper over $S_0$ (for $X_0\to S_0$) if and only if $j_0(\operatorname{Supp}\mathcal F_0)$ is proper over $S$ (for $X\to S$) [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]; so the equivalence of (2) identifies the systems with $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F_0)$ proper over $S_0$ with $\mathit{Coh}_{\text{support proper over }S}(X,\mathcal I)$.

proof.text: X is Noetherian by isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType f. For each n, quotientBaseChange_closedImmersion_ideal gives closedness and the extended quotient ideal; quotientBaseChange_extendedIdeal_mul_pow identifies it with J^(n+1).
Apply thickeningSystems_pushforward_equivalence with these geometric facts and the supplied adjunctions, obtaining Φ, β, its equivalence instance, and the adjacent-transition equation.
Apply thickeningSystems_completion_comparison to Φ, β and the transition equation. Obtain c, R, r, ρ and the three canonical unit/restriction/quotient equations.

Full faithfulness gives a hom-set equivalence, composed with Iso.homCongr along ρ to prove the requested bijection. Naturality of ρ and cancellation of its inverse prove the equation for completion.map. Compose FullyFaithful.isoEquiv with isoCongrLeft along ρ.symm to obtain the isomorphism bijection and its specified formula.

For j_0, closedImmersion_coherent_support gives the equality of nonzero-stalk loci. The image of a closed support under j_0 is closed. A reduced closed subscheme realizing the source support composes with j_0 to realize its image. The structure-independence theorem for closed subsets makes properness equivalent to properness of this composite subscheme map. The pullback square and properness of Spec(A/I) → Spec A give the forward implication by composition and the reverse by IsProper.of_comp. In reverse, the source support is the preimage of the closed image support, by injectivity of j_0, so no extra support-closedness lemma is needed.

Apply the preceding support result to M.term 0, coherent by M.coherent 0. Evaluation β_0 is an isomorphism with its pushforward. Apply the stalk functor to this isomorphism: its underlying equivalence preserves Subsingleton, hence the nonzero-stalk locus and HasSupportProperOver. This proves the final proper-support equivalence.

    {X : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (I : Ideal A)
    (i : ∀ n : ℕ, pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ⟶
        pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
    (hi : ∀ n : ℕ,
      i n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))) =
          pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    (hi₂ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      i n ≫ pullback.snd f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))) =

        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := I) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
    (ai : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i n))
    (aj : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) ⊣

    ∃ hX : IsNoetherian X,

          (I ^ (n + 1)))))) ∧

            (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
            A)).inv.hom)).comap f ^ (n + 1)) ∧
      ∃ (Φ : CoherentThickeningSystem (fun n ↦ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) i ⥤
          @CoherentFormalModule X hX ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso

          (((Φ.obj M).obj).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) ≫ (β n).hom.app M =

            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom

              (M.term n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (hi n)).hom.app (M.term n)) ∧
        ∃ (c : ∀ n : ℕ,
            Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) ⋙

          (R : CoherentModules X ⥤ CoherentThickeningSystem (fun n ↦ pullback f (Spec.map

                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).obj
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom

              (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                  (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).map ((c n).hom.app F) =
            (aj n).unit.app F) ∧

            ((R.obj F).comparison n).hom ≫ (r n).hom.app F =

                (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).map ((r n).hom.app F) =
            (aj n).unit.app F.obj) ∧
          (∀ F G : CoherentModules X,
            Function.Bijective (fun v : R.obj G ⟶ R.obj F ↦
              (ρ.hom.app G) ≫ Φ.map v ≫ (ρ.inv.app F))) ∧

            (ρ.hom.app G) ≫ Φ.map (R.map v) ≫ (ρ.inv.app F) =
              (@completion X hX ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso
                  (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)).map v) ∧
          (∀ (F : CoherentModules X)
            (M : CoherentThickeningSystem (fun n ↦ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom

            ∃ b : (R.obj F ≅ M) ≃

            {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton
